title: Excess Cash Flow
desc: Route leftover monthly cash into a brokerage for higher returns.
to-teach: Invest excess cash flow into brokerages.
hints: Your net monthly surplus after living expenses is $1,000.
Open a brokerage account and set an automatic monthly transfer of $1,000 from Checking.

client.name: Elena
client.description: Elena has $1,000 sitting idle every month in a 0% checking account after all bills are covered.
client.prompt: I have $1,000 left over every month. I don't want it sitting in a 0% checking account, I want to invest it!
